title: Talk:Passive
html:
Note

Any data changed here may also need to be changed on:

  • Fighter_Skills
  • Mage_Skills
  • Ranger_Skills

Don't forget to change the template name:

Skill_PassiveTable_Entry

to:

  • Skill_FighterTable_Entry
  • Skill_MageTable_Entry
  • Skill_RangerTable_Entry

respectively.

This table actually contains data for all skills including the non-player effect, starting and other
Why? it makes it easier to copy across the multiple tables believe it or not. This table makes use of: Template:Skill_PassiveTable_Entry, see assoicated talk.

Effectively, it looks for type=passive and type=Passive and ignores all other entries. The unused data is retained but not used in the table. The only difference between the various table entries is the name of the template used, and those are all similar in nature.

--Spetsdod 11:56, 7 February 2008 (CET)
